# Barcelona Big Blues Band

> Rhythm & blues big band from Barcelona (Spain) led by double bassist Ivan Kovacevic. Blues, swing and rhythm & blues in big band format. Available for concerts, festivals and private events.

## Key facts
- Name: Barcelona Big Blues Band
- Based in: Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain
- Director: Ivan Kovacevic (double bass)
- Genres: Rhythm & blues, Blues, Swing, Big Band
- Website languages: Catalan, Spanish, English (CA / ES / EN)
- Booking contact: bookingb4@gmail.com
- Website: https://barcelonabigbluesband.com/
